row1_p1: Aneira Thomas's practice explores her deep connection with nature and produces surfaces full of movement, patterns and layers.
row1_p2: Whilst reminiscing her memories, she pulls visual prompts from organic details of nature as a symbol of time passing.
row2_p1: Through bright colourful surfaces, Thomas longs to feel connected to nature and explores this relationship through mark making.
row2_p2: Her practice includes many slower paced methods such as extracting natural pigments, making canvas stretcher bars and using traditional painting techniques.
row3_p1: These methods encourage her audience to slow their pace, reflect on their memories and regain a bond with the natural world.
row3_p2: Thomas approaches her work using a variety of mediums, which allows her to work with several layers that weave into one harmonious surface.
